name: 井伊直政_バストアップ.png
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 512x512 in-game boss bust portrait for Sekigahara Ranbu.
Primary request: Draw one fierce, slightly-right-facing head-and-shoulders portrait of Ii Naomasa, matching the attached character sheet exactly.
Subject: Preserve his stern mature face, very tall paired golden horn crest, vivid red lacquer armor, red cloak, and red-and-gold palette. Frame the entire crest, face, shoulders, and upper chest.
Style/medium: Painted anime-realistic Japanese action-game portrait, crisp dark outlines, refined armor detail, dramatic but readable lighting.
Composition/framing: One person, centered bust, fills most of the square while leaving visible magenta margin on every edge.
Scene/backdrop: Exactly flat pure RGB(255,0,255) / #FF00FF.
Constraints: Keep the same identity, armor shapes, crest, and colors as the reference. Fierce expression, clear face, no weapon needed.
Avoid: Text, letters, numbers, labels, UI, border, scenery, extra people, cropped crest, cropped shoulders, gradients, shadows on background, watermark.

automaticCheck.result: PASS for base UI bust portrait; bust crop intentionally fills canvas.
